title: A Stunning Nebula Image Predicts How Our Sun Will Die - Nautilus
gist: Astrophotographer Andrew McCarthy's 30-hour image of the Dumbbell Nebula (M27) illustrates how the Sun is expected to look after dying in about five billion years.

insights.claim: The Sun will in roughly five billion years resemble the M27 planetary nebula, a cloud of gas and dust ejected by a dying star and lit by its last embers.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: Educational astronomy content with no market implication.
insights.locator: Fast-forward five billion years or so

insights.claim: The M27 image was captured by Andrew McCarthy over 30 hours across several nights, showing oxygen in blue and hydrogen and sulfur in orange.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: Shows the amateur astrophotography capability level.
